commentary: August revenue of [[revenue.month.actual]] came in above budget by [[revenue.month.vs_budget]] (£190,000 budget) and up on last year by [[revenue.month.vs_py]], with gross margin at [[gross_margin.month.actual]], above budget by [[gross_margin.month.vs_budget_pp]] and up on last year by [[gross_margin.month.vs_py_pp]], taking operating profit to [[operating_profit.month.actual]], above budget by [[operating_profit.month.vs_budget]].
